channel.title: Early Trends
channel.description: New early-trend product picks from Early Trends. Free RSS; no account required.

item.title: MGA Miniverse Animals Series 3
item.description: MGA Miniverse Animals Series 3, $8.99 on the official shop: a new animals capsule in a line the brand already merchandises as a bestseller. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: Bala Bangles

item.description: Yoto Mini 4th Gen, $109.99, announced September 10, 2026. Screen-free audio is the product description, not a developmental claim. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early–mid.

item.title: Loop Quiet 2
item.description: Loop Quiet 2 earplugs, $24.95. WIRED’s March 30, 2026 earplug guide recommends them for sleep. Not a medical claim. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Mid.

item.title: Fellow Opus 2

item.title: Pop Mart Twinkle Twinkle
item.description: Pop Mart’s Twinkle Twinkle plush pendants: reported minute-long sell-outs and resale above retail in China, and a US series that launched on 1 October 2026. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early in the West.

item.title: Kitsch zig-zag headbands

item.title: The Unselected Journals of Emma M. Lion
item.description: Beth Brower’s Emma M. Lion journals: Bloomsbury bought volumes 1–8 after self-publishing, and signed volume 9. A BookTok claim from a shop blog is marked as a weak signal. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.

item.title: FiiO DM13 portable CD player
item.description: The FiiO DM13 is a portable CD player in a wider wave of young people buying CD players again. Category demand is cited; a sell-out of this model is not. Identified on October 28, 2026 (2026-10-28). Stage at identification: Early.

item.title: Brick phone blocker
